units.source_text: 有的女子，态度冷酷顽强，异常缺乏情趣，过分一本正经，完全不解事理。

en.t: Some women are cold and stubborn in manner, unusually lacking in charm, far too solemn, and utterly unable to understand how things are.

units.source_text: 然而这态度终于行不通，后来只得放弃素志，嫁了一个平凡的丈夫。

en.t: Yet such an attitude could not succeed in the end, and later they had no choice but to give up their original resolve and marry an ordinary husband.

units.source_text: 所以，对这种女子，源氏公子起初与之交往而后来中绝的，亦复不少。

en.t: For this reason, there were quite a few such women with whom Prince Genji first became involved, only for the relationship to be broken off later.

units.source_text: 他有时想起那个顽强的空蝉，心中不免怨恨。

en.t: At times he thought of that stubborn Utsusemi, and could not help feeling resentment in his heart.

units.source_text: 遇着适当机会，有时也写封信给轩端荻。

en.t: When a suitable occasion arose, he would sometimes write a letter to Nokiba no Ogi as well.

units.source_text: 那天晚上在灯光之下对弈时她那种娇痴妩媚之态，他至今不忘，很想再看一看。

en.t: He still could not forget the innocent and alluring way she had looked that night as they played go beneath the lamplight, and he very much wished to see her once more.

units.source_text: 总而言之，但凡接触过的人，源氏公子始终不忘。

en.t: In short, Prince Genji never forgot anyone with whom he had once had dealings.
